rule: Every entry needs owner, approvers, rationale, risk, compensating controls and an expiry. Expired or unowned entries fail the release gate. No entry is 'active' until a named approver signs.

entries.title: HMAC token trust root instead of mTLS/SPIFFE or OIDC
entries.rationale: stdlib-only boundary for this archive; interface is replaceable
entries.risk: shared-key compromise lets an attacker mint tokens until rotation

entries.title: in-process idempotency cache and rate windows (not shared across replicas)
entries.risk: multi-replica deployments double-count or miss replays

entries.title: no edge power/thermal measurement on constrained hardware
entries.rationale: no far-edge device available to this build
entries.risk: unknown energy cost per pack on ARM/low-power nodes

entries.title: lower_bound() default counts unplaceable workloads (4.2.0 semantics)
entries.risk: callers relying on default overstate the bound
